newsitem.title: USA: New England Funds plans to launch small-cap fund.
newsitem.headline: New England Funds plans to launch small-cap fund.

text.p: New England Funds said it plans to launch the New England Star Small Cap Fund, slated to begin on Dec 31.

The firm said at least 65 percent of assets will be in companies with market capitalization below $1 billion, and the fund will also invest in larger-cap issues, fixed income and foreign securities, which will be kept to 25 percent of net assets.
The fund will have multiple managers -- Loomis Sayles & Co LP, Montgomery Asset Management LP, Harris Associates LP, and Robertson Stephens & Co Investment Management LP.
New England Funds is a unit of New England Investment Cos LP.
